entities.title: On a pull request
entities.summary: Laumufarþegi is typechecked, tested and built, and every .dev diagram and knowledge file is validated.
entities.trigger: A pull request that changes games/laumufarthegi outside its .dev folders, or anything under .github/ outside .github/.dev (ci.yml).
checks: npm test: tsc --noEmit, build.mjs --test, then the node:test suites in dist-test/
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
python3 Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py, for the whole repository
notChecked: The page in a real browser, and the Durable Object on Cloudflare's runtime: the tests fake it.
A change only to games/word-lists/: it does not count as a change to this game.

entities.title: Deploying, by hand
entities.summary: The owner runs npm run deploy: the tests, the build, then wrangler deploy.
entities.trigger: The owner, on their own machine; nothing deploys from GitHub's runners.
secrets: A Cloudflare API token for the icelander.net account, on the owner's machine
